model_id: airkingbd/dplm2_650m (HF, pytorch_model.bin 2,693,742,215 bytes, last modified 2025-04-19) + structure tokenizer airkingbd/struct_tokenizer (dplm2_struct_tokenizer.ckpt)
code: bytedance/dplm @ 8a2e15e (README protocol 'Forward Folding'), patched only for python 3.11 dataclass defaults and the missing openfold CUDA extension

settings.input: sequence only; all structure tokens masked
settings.note: the official script batches up to 50 length-sorted targets with padding; we decode one target at a time because batched decoding with padding changes the argmax trajectory (only ~41% of targets identical; mean TM vs ground ground_truth 0.602 batched vs 0.613 single on 59 CAMEO-2022 targets)

hardware: NVIDIA H200; GPUs were shared with other jobs for part of the run, so seconds_per_protein is inflated and not a clean speed measurement
training_data_cutoff: no date cutoff stated in the README; per our reading of the DPLM-2 paper the training data are experimental PDB structures plus AFDB-SwissProt predicted structures (not re-verified here)

reproduction_gate.test_set: DPLM-2 CAMEO 2022 (Zenodo 15424801, 183 targets; 163 with 60<=L<=512 as in their evaluator)
reproduction_gate.outcome: RMSD reproduced (within 0.11 A); TM not reproduced (0.08 lower), cause not found

sanity.scorer: python/eval/metrics.py all_metrics on CA, residues with finite ref coords
